sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed a WA Police investigation into misconduct allegations arising from a carpark encounter at the Perth Convention and Exhibition Centre.
sentences.section: The Commission’s Decision to Review the Investigation
sentences.support: the Commission decided to undertake a review pursuant to s 41 of the CCM Act.

sentences.text: The review examined the investigation’s treatment of a search, a request for personal details, a move on order and the reasonableness of officers’ actions.
sentences.support: The investigation did not consider all the issues raised by the referred allegations

sentences.text: The Commission considered the investigation inadequate and concluded that police could not properly find the search lawful because consent had been refused.
sentences.support:
In the Commission's opinion, the investigation by WA Police into the referred allegations was 
inadequate.

sentences.text: The Commission made one recommendation requiring training on declared-area powers and operational briefings when those powers were to be used.

In the Commission's opinion, the investigation by WA Police into the referred allegations was 
inadequate.

The investigation did not consider all the issues raised by the referred allegations 
and there were other aspects of the investigation which concerned the Commission.

notes: The Outcome of the Review is the findings synopsis. The review assesses the police investigation and does not substitute a disciplinary outcome. Paragraph 83 appears to omit “not” after “did”; no claim relies on that clause.
